notes:
Passed on the fake backend only; no hardware or real-simulator run was made. The upstream FurnitureSim-v0 needs Isaac Gym, CUDA, Linux and Python <3.9 (setup.py:7-31, README.md:28), so the sim backend (gym.make) was not run and the preferred upstream simulator was unavailable; fake.py is a pure Python kinematic stand-in for FurnitureSimEnv. NOT COVERED: the 224 x 224 resized or 1280 x 720 full-resolution camera images (the fake returns 2 x 2 x 3 placeholders, and the real sizes are named in the fidelity gaps); rotation semantics (the quaternion part of the action and ee_quat are not modelled); the assembly reward and parts_poses; multiple environments and the upstream batch dimension; rendering, viewer and video. The fake is F0, not the upstream Isaac Gym PhysX simulator (F1), and it was not compared with the upstream environment. All Facts are upstream_code with a clone path and line; no vendor_doc was used. G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. Warnings left: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for close (inherited from the external gym.Env base, which the clone does not define), and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the bridge-derived ticks/seed integers and the simulator action values (the same family warnings as the exemplar). No catalogue_requests: only the cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 classes are used. The clone was not modified.
